import Mathlib

theorem mathd_algebra_214_bounded_height_fiber
  (a b c : ℝ)
  (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (h₀ : ∀ x, f x = a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c)
  (h₁ : IsExtrOn f Set.univ 2)
  (h₂ : f 2 = 3)
  (h₃ : f 4 = 4)
  (h : ℝ)
  
   :
  ∀ x : ℝ, f x = h ↔ (x - 2) ^ 2 = 4 * (h - 3) := by
  have hf2 : f 2 = a * 2 ^ 2 + b * 2 + c := h₀ 2
  have hf4 : f 4 = a * 4 ^ 2 + b * 4 + c := h₀ 4
  rcases h₁ with hmin | hmax
  · have hm1 : f 2 ≤ f (2 + 1) := hmin (Set.mem_univ (2 + 1))
    have hm3 : f 2 ≤ f (2 - (4 * a + b)) := hmin (Set.mem_univ (2 - (4 * a + b)))
    have hf21 : f (2 + 1) = a * (2 + 1) ^ 2 + b * (2 + 1) + c := h₀ (2 + 1)
    have hf23 : f (2 - (4 * a + b)) = a * (2 - (4 * a + b)) ^ 2 + b * (2 - (4 * a + b)) + c := h₀ (2 - (4 * a + b))
    have h_id : 4 * (a * (2 - (4 * a + b)) ^ 2 + b * (2 - (4 * a + b)) + c - 3) +
        (2 * (4 * a + b) + 1 + 2) * (4 * a + b) ^ 2 =
        (4 - (4 * a + b) ^ 2) * (a * 2 ^ 2 + b * 2 + c - 3) +
        (4 * a + b) ^ 2 * (a * 4 ^ 2 + b * 4 + c - 4) := by ring
    have h_lin : 2 * (4 * a + b) + 1 ≥ 0 := by linarith [h₂, hm1, hf21, hf2, hf4, h₃]
    have h_sq : (4 * a + b) ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [h₂, hm3, hf23, hf2, hf4, h₃, h_id, h_lin]
    have ha : a = 1 / 4 := by nlinarith [h₂, h₃, hf2, hf4, h_sq]
    have hb : b = -1 := by nlinarith [h₂, h₃, hf2, hf4, h_sq]
    have hc : c = 4 := by nlinarith [h₂, h₃, hf2, hf4, h_sq]
    intro x
    have hfx := h₀ x
    constructor
    · intro hx; nlinarith
    · intro hx; nlinarith
  · have : f 4 ≤ f 2 := hmax (Set.mem_univ 4)
    linarith [h₂, h₃]
